ssism_record.author: U Ingar Soe
ssism_record.session_title: The Birth of the Sentinel Philosophy

purpose.statement: This record preserves the philosophical foundations discovered during one morning ritual. It is intended for future learning, not immediate publication.

sentinel_definition.title: What is Sentinel?
sentinel_definition.definition: Sentinel is not a software project. Sentinel is a disciplined learning ecosystem where ethical intention, engineering, verification, publication, review, and continuous improvement become one lifelong practice.

engineering_principle.quote: Sophisticated engineering. Simple workflow. Humble heart.

discipline_principle.quote: Sentinel began with ordinary resources, but extraordinary discipline.

learning_principle.quote: Sentinel proves that disciplined learning can multiply the value of ordinary tools.

editorial_principle.quote: Publication preserves today's knowledge. Review prepares tomorrow's wisdom.

legacy_principle.quote: Legacy is built one review at a time.

ethical_foundation.daily_question: How can I become more useful today?

future_message.to_future_self: If you are reading this years later, remember that Sentinel was never about the technology of 2026. It was about the daily discipline of learning with humility. Technologies will change. The workflow may evolve. But if your heart remains dedicated to truth, compassion, careful verification, and continuous learning, then Sentinel is still alive.

closing_reflection.statement: Engineering changes tools. Wisdom changes people. Build both.
